source_records.summary: The pinned Programme WP00 source package is indexed retrospectively.
Corrected Disegni universal p-adic Gross-Zagier source is qualified for bounded downstream applicability checking at p=2; it does not establish the complex BSD leading-term identity.

Friedberg-Hoffstein prescribed-local quadratic-twist nonvanishing is qualified for auxiliary imaginary quadratic field existence in a compatible local sign packet; it does not establish reciprocity or BSD.

Burungale-Castella-Kim identify the exact odd-p primitivity-to-Sha/index mechanism under p>3, while Chao Li proves a bounded mod-2 obstruction to the standard rank-lowering step; together they exclude a mechanical p=2 specialization of that proof technology.

Barrios-Mok, Jetchev, Kriz-Li, and Yan-Zhu are bound as a bounded source screen: square-class transport does not determine unsquared 2-adic length; the Tamagawa-aware Kolyvagin bound is odd-p; the positive BSD(2) twist lane is restricted; and the contemporary non-CM ordinary main-conjecture application assumes p>2.

Poonen-Stoll bind the Cassels-Tate pairing on Sha modulo its divisible subgroup; for elliptic curves the pairing is alternating. Downstream may combine this with independently established finiteness and elementary finite-group algebra.

Bullach-Burns is qualified as a p=2-aware Nekovar-Selmer/Euler-system determinant/Fitting framework whose Theorem 4.20 is unavailable for the selected E[2] because Hypothesis 4.14(ii*) requires residual dimension one at p=2; its rational elliptic application separately assumes p>3. Muller is recorded as a genuine split-2 imaginary-quadratic main conjecture comparator for a different class-field/elliptic-unit module.

Kato 2004 is qualified for genuine p=2 ordinary Iwasawa control away from the height-one prime containing 2. The all-height-one upgrade in Theorem 17.4(3), and the integral divisibility clause Theorem 12.5(4), explicitly assume p not equal to 2. Kato therefore confirms rather than discharges the protected cyclotomic height-one (2) / relative-mu defect.

Bertolini-Longo-Venerucci require p>=5; Kramer nonzero-mu2 families use rational 2-power isogenies and hence reducible E[2]; Lin-Yin's public 2026 mu abstract assumes reducible E[2]; Chakravarthy's irreducible-residual Greenberg conjecture is stated for odd p and corrected v2 does not determine fixed p=2; Deng-Li provide integral p=2 finite-layer techniques on a supersingular branch. None of these screened interfaces controls the selected good-ordinary surjective E[2] Fitting invariant.

Greenberg 1999 is qualified for literal p=2 good-ordinary local control on the primitive classical-Kummer quotient: at base level over Q_2, the ambient local restriction kernel has order #E_tilde(F_2)[2^infinity]^2. The source does not determine the globally hit subgroup or any BSD leading-term determinant.

Greenberg 1999 is qualified at p=2 for the primitive classical-Kummer Poitou-Tate global-local incidence interface: global images are exact orthogonal complements and the dual of the primitive global-to-local cokernel is the localized compact self-dual Selmer image. The source does not evaluate the resulting rank-one character on the finite ambient kernel.

Tan 2010 Corollary 2.3.3 is qualified for arbitrary local Galois extensions: H^1(Gal(L/K),A(L)) is exactly Pontryagin-dual to the compact projective-limit norm quotient of the dual abelian variety. The source applies to the selected local Z_2 cyclotomic extensions at both v=2 and odd v, and it does not itself evaluate the class of the saturated global generator.

Tan 2010 Theorems 1–2 are qualified literally at p=2 for the totally ramified local cyclotomic extension: the formal universal-norm quotient injects into the full universal-norm quotient, the quotient is induced by reduction, and the norm sequence is Pontryagin-dual to the corresponding formal/reduction local cohomology sequence.

Hall's reconstruction of Lubin-Rosen/Mazur is qualified literally at p=2 for a map-level height-one formal norm coordinate: individual formal points pass through a toroidal power-series model and an explicit local-class-field commutative diagram to the quotient Gamma/(1-u)Gamma. Only element-order invariance is admitted; no unit-root, logarithm, Bockstein, or regulator identification is supplied.

Lai–Longhi–Tan–Trihan are qualified literally at p=2 for the Mazur/Tan twist convention: twist-matrix eigenvalues are exactly the p-adic unit-root Frobenius eigenvalues. In the elliptic one-dimensional specialization this gives u=alpha and exact principal-ideal equality between the Hall/Tan formal norm modulus and either unit-root factor (1-alpha) or (1-alpha^-1).

status_records.summary: Programme promotion and claim state remain authoritative at the pinned commit.

Corrected p=2 p-adic Gross-Zagier and auxiliary-K nonvanishing interfaces are qualified; standard odd-p Heegner-primitivity is non-transferable mechanically; the bounded p=2 length-route screen leaves exact unsquared uniform 2-primary arithmetic length unresolved; Cassels-Tate supports square-class analysis; WP17A finds a residual-dimension barrier in Bullach-Burns; WP17B confirms Kato misses height-one (2); WP17C isolates the remaining source gap specifically on the selected good-ordinary irreducible/surjective E[2] branch.

Greenberg's primitive good-ordinary local control theorem is source-qualified at p=2 and computes the ambient base local kernel exactly. The remaining WP21 D1b defect is global-local incidence: determining which ambient local kernel classes are hit by global localization.

Greenberg's p=2 primitive Poitou-Tate interface is source-qualified for replacing the global-hit subgroup problem by an exact annihilator/character problem against the localized compact self-dual Selmer direction. The image order of that character remains a downstream mathematical unknown.

Tan's local duality theorem is source-qualified for representing each local control-cohomology factor by the exact projective-limit norm quotient of E over the corresponding local cyclotomic Z_2-extension. Stabilization and the order of the saturated-generator class remain downstream mathematical obligations.

Tan's good-ordinary local norm theorem is source-qualified literally at p=2 for the totally ramified local cyclotomic extension. It supplies the exact formal-to-full-to-reduction universal-norm filtration and its dual cohomological sequence; evaluating the saturated generator's remaining formal norm class is still a downstream mathematical obligation.

Hall/Lubin-Rosen supply a source-qualified element-level toroidal/local-class-field coordinate for the remaining height-one formal universal-norm class at p=2. Its element order is preserved, but its value and any unit-root/logarithm/Bockstein normalization remain downstream obligations.

The Mazur/Tan twist convention is now source-qualified literally at p=2: in dimension one u equals the ordinary unit root alpha, and (1-u)Gamma_2, (1-alpha)Gamma_2, and (1-alpha^-1)Gamma_2 are the same submodule. The selected toroidal depth and all determinant/Bockstein comparisons remain open.

failed_routes.summary: Native Forge fixtures and broad failed-route ledgers were not established before the retrospective manifest.
The corrected p-adic Gross-Zagier interface may not be promoted mechanically to the selected complex 2-primary BSD valuation or to control of the height-one (2) component.
Auxiliary quadratic twist nonvanishing supplies a suitable field but no p-adic height formula, mu equality, integral index formula, or complex BSD valuation.

The standard odd-p level-raising/rank-lowering/primitivity route to the exact Heegner-index formula cannot be specialized mechanically to p=2; Chao Li proves an actual rank-lowering obstruction under a stronger surjective residual subcase.
Modulo-rational-squares transport and the screened odd-p or restricted-family results do not by themselves provide the exact unsquared uniform p=2 arithmetic length required by BSD-R2-A1.

Bullach-Burns Theorem 4.20 requires Hypothesis 4.14(ii*), which at p=2 forces residual dimension one. The selected elliptic residual representation E[2] has dimension two over F2, so the theorem cannot be applied directly to the selected p=2 curve. This is an applicability barrier for the screened theorem, not a no-go theorem for future p=2 Selmer-complex methods.

Kato Theorem 17.4(2) gives p=2 ordinary control only at height-one primes not containing p. The all-height-one upgrade Theorem 17.4(3) and integral divisibility Theorem 12.5(4) explicitly assume p not equal to 2. This leaves the protected height-one (2) / relative-mu component unresolved.

The bounded WP17C screen finds no admissible exact integral theorem among the named nearby routes for the selected good-ordinary surjective E[2] branch: anticyclotomic main conjectures screened require p>=5; known positive mu2 constructions/classifications screened are residually reducible; current irreducible-residual mu theory screened is odd-prime; finite-layer p=2 comparator is supersingular. This is a bounded applicability result, not theorem nonexistence.

The remaining local downstream debt is to evaluate the selected saturated generator's toroidal congruence depth, or source an exact comparison that makes it mechanically computable. Separate source debt remains for the height-one (2)/mu analytic-determinant contribution in a form composing exactly with the WP16B primitive Kummer Fitting invariant, and for the WP20 Bockstein/WP00 normalization. The screened p=2 positive results otherwise lie in reducible, supersingular, or different-motive branches, while the closest irreducible-residual and anticyclotomic results retain odd-prime hypotheses.

non_certification_statement: This retrospective manifest preserves immutable Programme history while registering qualified native Forge provider evidence. It now admits Greenberg's literal p=2 primitive good-ordinary local-control theorem, his p=2 primitive Poitou-Tate global-local incidence interface, Tan's arbitrary-Galois local cohomology/norm duality interface, Tan's literal-p=2 totally ramified good-ordinary reduction/formal universal-norm filtration, Hall/Lubin-Rosen's height-one map-level toroidal formal norm coordinate construction, and the exact literal-p=2 reconciliation of the Mazur/Tan twist scalar with the ordinary unit root. It does not change campaign authority, prove BSD-R2-A1, evaluate the resulting saturated-generator toroidal congruence depth, establish a p=2 main conjecture or exact analytic determinant theorem for the selected non-CM elliptic representation, identify the WP20 Bockstein with a regulator/local factor, assert literature exhaustiveness, or imply MATHCERT certification.
